title: 单线程 CPU
summary: 任务有入队时间和处理时长；CPU 空闲时选择已入队处理中时长最短、再下标最小者，返回处理顺序。
insight: 任务按入队时间排序，用小根堆维护当前可执行任务并按 [processing,index] 排序。堆空时把当前时间跳到下一任务入队时刻。
pitfalls: 同时可用时按处理时长后下标排序

solutions.title: 入队排序与就绪堆
solutions.idea: 按事件时间把任务加入符合调度规则的优先队列。
steps: 构造 [enqueue,processing,index] 并按 enqueue 排序
while 未完成：堆空时 time=max(time,next.enqueue)；把 enqueue<=time 全部入堆
弹出 processing 最小任务，记录 index，time+=processing

code.java: class Solution { public int[] getOrder(int[][] tasks){int n=tasks.length;int[][] indexed=new int[n][3];for(int i=0;i<n;i++)indexed[i]=new int[]{tasks[i][0],tasks[i][1],i};Arrays.sort(indexed,Comparator.comparingInt(a->a[0]));PriorityQueue<int[]> ready=new PriorityQueue<>((a,b)->a[1]!=b[1]?a[1]-b[1]:a[2]-b[2]);int[] answer=new int[n];int next=0,done=0;long time=0;while(done<n){if(ready.isEmpty())time=Math.max(time,indexed[next][0]);while(next<n&&indexed[next][0]<=time)ready.offer(indexed[next++]);int[] task=ready.poll();answer[done++]=task[2];time+=task[1];}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun getOrder(tasks:Array<IntArray>):IntArray{val indexed=tasks.indices.map{intArrayOf(tasks[it][0],tasks[it][1],it)}.sortedBy{it[0]};val ready=java.util.PriorityQueue<IntArray>{a,b->if(a[1]!=b[1])a[1]-b[1] else a[2]-b[2]};val answer=IntArray(tasks.size);var next=0;var done=0;var time=0L;while(done<tasks.size){if(ready.isEmpty())time=maxOf(time,indexed[next][0].toLong());while(next<tasks.size&&indexed[next][0]<=time)ready.add(indexed[next++]);val task=ready.remove();answer[done++]=task[2];time+=task[1]};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: vector<int> getOrder(vector<vector<int>>& tasks){vector<array<int,3>> indexed;for(int i=0;i<(int)tasks.size();++i)indexed.push_back({tasks[i][0],tasks[i][1],i});sort(indexed.begin(),indexed.end());priority_queue<pair<int,int>,vector<pair<int,int>>,greater<pair<int,int>>> ready;vector<int> answer;int next=0;long long time=0;while(answer.size()<tasks.size()){if(ready.empty())time=max(time,1LL*indexed[next][0]);while(next<(int)tasks.size()&&indexed[next][0]<=time){ready.push({indexed[next][1],indexed[next][2]});++next;}auto [duration,index]=ready.top();ready.pop();answer.push_back(index);time+=duration;}return answer;} };
